title: Mixed-State Entanglement in a Minimal Model of Quantum Chaos
summary: Understanding the dynamics of quantum correlations in many-body systems is a central problem in non-equilibrium quantum physics. We study the spread of mixed-state entanglement in a minimal model of quantum chaos, the kicked field Ising model. By combining the replica trick with the space-time duality of the model, we determine the exact spectrum of the partially transposed reduced density matrix.
